Terms.services_waas_desc: Development and maintenance of websites and landing pages under a monthly subscription model. Includes hosting, SSL, domain, technical support, and content updates according to the contracted plan.

waas_terms_items.title: Subscription Model (WaaS):
waas_terms_items.desc: The service works under a subscription or "lease" model. The website is online and operational only while the monthly payment is active and up to date.

waas_terms_items.title: Code Ownership:
waas_terms_items.desc: Tecnonets maintains the intellectual and technical ownership of the source code, infrastructure, and implementation. The client has the right of use and commercial exploitation of the site during the plan's validity.

waas_terms_items.title: Support and Maintenance:
waas_terms_items.desc: Includes uptime monitoring, security patches, and technical support for server failures or crashes to guarantee site stability.

waas_terms_items.title: Monthly Changes Policy:
waas_terms_items.desc: Landing Pages: 1 minor monthly change. Corporate Site: 2 minor monthly changes (no redesigns).

waas_terms_items.title: Blog and Content:
waas_terms_items.desc: Technical structure is delivered; article writing is not included.

waas_terms_items.title: Code Buyout:
waas_terms_items.desc: If you wish to migrate and own the code, you can request a buyout fee quote.
